info.description:
LUNARIS — Lunar Mission Intelligence & Surface Operations Platform.

Milestone 01 API: service health, scientific toolchain report, dataset registry with
local provenance status, and a registry of user-defined candidate sites.

Conventions: snake_case fields; units as suffixes (`_deg`, `_m`, `_s`, `_bytes`);
timestamps ISO 8601 UTC; coordinates planetocentric in the MOON_ME frame with east
longitude in [0, 360). Every non-2xx response uses the `ErrorResponse` envelope.

LUNARIS is a preliminary mission-planning and research tool, not a certified
spacecraft landing system.
info.summary: Lunar Mission Intelligence & Surface Operations Platform
info.title: LUNARIS API

get.description:
One row per site; every cell carries its own evidence (kind, method, sources with
manifest id and SHA-256 or URL/ETag, units, limitations). A cell that cannot be
computed is null with a `reason`, never 0. The default window is calendar year 2027
at a 1 h step (8 761 samples, within the ephemeris sample cap).

The `summary.recommendation` names the best-fitting site for the stated mission: how
much it needs power, comms and landing safety (`none|low|medium|high`) and optional hard
limits. Sites that break a limit are excluded with the reason, never down-weighted;
every weight and scale is returned as assumption evidence.

post.description:
Visible fraction of the solar and Earth disks at every step from ``start_utc`` to
``end_utc``, against the astronomical horizon and, when a horizon mask exists, the
terrain horizon (reported separately). Summaries: mean visible disk fraction,
illuminated / visible fraction, longest illumination and darkness (or visibility and
outage) with censoring, and windows. Same window rules, cap (10 000 samples) and error
codes as the ephemeris endpoint. Earth results are geometric line of sight only and do
not imply a radio link.
